title: A broken chain write restores only a verified full backup after native writers settle
steps: Run the chain recovery wrapper with a healthy initial home, a verified full backup, explicit server failures after the write, and settled native turn records. Exercise transient reads, content-only faults, files-only backups and missing native records.
expect: A confirmed broken home restores the pinned full backup through the idempotent owner restore operation and verifies the resulting home.
Missing full backups refuse writes; ordinary content faults and network failures never restore demo content.
Unsettled or missing native request records block restore; pending restore operations never report success.
fence: chain full-backup pin, positive native writer settlement and verified restore operation

tests: a write that breaks a previously healthy site restores its pinned full backup and verifies the home
ordinary content faults and transient reads never restore the template
a missing full baseline refuses writes instead of advertising a files-only recovery point
missing settlement evidence prevents a restore even when no open turn is listed
recovery pins only a full backup and restores through one verified, idempotent customer operation
step 9 proves native writer settlement from every prompted request record
chain recovery uses the real owner backup and restore routes with a verified full point
